Box type.label: Box type
Box type.plainEnglishDefinition: Full 5-sided plywood carcass (top, bottom, two sides, and back panel) with internal shelves, 0.8mm inside laminate, and hinged or sliding shutters with 1mm outside laminate finish. Billed by front-face area (Height × Width).

Frame type.label: Frame type
Frame type.plainEnglishDefinition: Perimeter plywood frame anchored directly to existing masonry recess or granite/kadappa shelves, fitted with laminated shutters on the front face. Billed by front-face area (Height × Width).

Loft - frame and shutter.label: Loft - frame and shutter
Loft - frame and shutter.plainEnglishDefinition: Overhead storage closure above a concrete loft slab or wardrobe top, consisting of a seasoned plywood frame and hinged shutters with 0.8mm inside laminate and 1mm outside laminate finish.

Low roof - frame and shutter.label: Low roof - frame and shutter
Low roof - frame and shutter.plainEnglishDefinition: Frame and shutter storage built under a sunken slab / low-roof ledge, finished with 0.8mm inside laminate and 1mm outside laminate finish.

Folding table.label: Folding table
Folding table.plainEnglishDefinition: 18" depth wall-mounted collapsible study or utility table finished on both top and bottom faces with 1mm outside laminate finish and heavy-duty folding brackets.

Wood wall paneling.label: Wood wall paneling
Wood wall paneling.plainEnglishDefinition: Flat plywood wall cladding installed under lofts, around pillars, main door jambs, or breakfast counters, finished on the visible face with 1mm outside laminate finish.

Wood wall paneling (under wall cabinet).label: Wood wall paneling (under wall cabinet)
Wood wall paneling (under wall cabinet).plainEnglishDefinition: Slim underside or backsplash plywood panelling beneath kitchen wall cabinets finished with 1mm outside laminate finish.

Louvers wall paneling.label: Louvers wall paneling
Louvers wall paneling.plainEnglishDefinition: Decorative fluted charcoal/wood louver and 1mm outside laminate wall panelling for TV units or above main door entrances.

Pooja CNC / glass door paneling.label: Pooja CNC / glass door paneling
Pooja CNC / glass door paneling.plainEnglishDefinition: Pooja room entrance framing and double doors incorporating decorative CNC jali / glass cut-outs and 1mm outside laminate finish.

Tandem or SS baskets.label: Tandem or SS baskets
Tandem or SS baskets.plainEnglishDefinition: Modular kitchen pull-out Tandem drawer box or stainless-steel (SS 304) basket complete with soft-close telescopic channels and fitting.

Wall mount bed.label: Wall mount bed
Wall mount bed.plainEnglishDefinition: Space-saving wall-mounted hydraulic/folding bed frame with 0.8mm inside laminate and 1mm outside laminate finish.

Mirror wall paneling.label: Mirror wall paneling
Mirror wall paneling.plainEnglishDefinition: Plywood backing panel with polished mirror mounting for dressing zones.

False ceiling (Saint Gobain).label: False ceiling (Saint Gobain)
False ceiling (Saint Gobain).plainEnglishDefinition: Gypsum false ceiling using Saint-Gobain boards and GI perimeter/intermediate channels.

notesAndExclusions: Laminate Thickness Standard: Internal balancing/liner laminate is industry-standard 0.8 mm class (actual manufacturer sheet gauge is 0.72 mm to 0.80 mm as per ISI/market tolerance). Outside decorative laminate is 1.0 mm thickness in the customer’s choice of finish (SF Matte or High-Gloss at same price).
For acrylic sheets, Aluminium profile doors, heavy glass, and bespoke CNC design work, additional charges are applicable as per selection.
Outside 1.0 mm decorative laminate is applied strictly on visible exterior surfaces.
If the customer selects hardware or plywood outside the listed allowance/brands, the rate difference is payable at actuals.
For any additional internal drawers beyond standard layout, ₹5,000 per drawer is charged on Premium/2026 quotes (₹4,500–₹4,000 on historical quotes as specified).
All prices shown are all-inclusive for the listed material and labour scope.

termsAndConditions.title: Order Confirmation Booking (₹50,000)
termsAndConditions.clause: The customer must pay ₹50,000 (or above) as booking advance to confirm the work order and freeze the quoted material rates. This verified booking payment counts once toward the 50% work-start advance.

termsAndConditions.title: 50% Work-Start Advance
termsAndConditions.clause: The customer must complete 50% of the total quotation value (less the verified ₹50,000 booking already paid) prior to material dispatch and commencement of carpentry work at site.

termsAndConditions.title: 35% Milestone Upon Plywood Structure Completion
termsAndConditions.clause: The customer must pay 35% of the total quotation value immediately upon completion of all plywood carcass and framing work at site.

termsAndConditions.title: 10% Milestone After Outside Laminate Completion
termsAndConditions.clause: The customer must pay 10% of the total quotation value upon completion of outside 1.0mm laminate pressing and shutter hanging.

termsAndConditions.title: 5% Final Balance Before Handover
termsAndConditions.clause: The customer must pay the final 5% balance in full prior to final hardware alignment and formal site handover.

termsAndConditions.title: Immediate Settlement for Extra Work
termsAndConditions.clause: Any extra work, additional drawers, or scope additions requested during execution must be approved in writing and paid immediately upon completion of that item.

termsAndConditions.title: Final Site Cleaning Responsibility
termsAndConditions.clause: Carpentry debris will be stacked neatly by the execution team; final deep site cleaning after work completion is the client’s responsibility.

termsAndConditions.title: Quotation Validity & Site Measurement Reconciliation
termsAndConditions.clause: This quotation is valid for 30 calendar days from the issue date. Where initial quantities are prepared from floor plans, final billing is reconciled against physical site laser/tape measurements before laminate stage.

termsAndConditions.title: Laminate Gauge & Finish Specification (0.8mm / 0.72mm Note)
termsAndConditions.clause: Internal balancing liner laminate is standard 0.8 mm market category (actual factory sheet thickness ranges between 0.72 mm and 0.80 mm as per manufacturer tolerance). Outside laminate is 1.0 mm thickness in the customer’s selected SF Matte or High-Gloss finish at no price difference.

termsAndConditions.title: Materials, Approved Alternatives & Manufacturer Warranties
termsAndConditions.clause: Listed alternatives allow sourcing within the approved brand schedule for each package; any different product requires written customer confirmation before purchase. Manufacturer plywood warranties (30/25/21 years on Premium or 20/15/10 years on Normal) are governed by the actual selected product’s manufacturer certificate, invoice, and terms.
